import json, re, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from tools.i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from tools.i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from tools.i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
root=Path.cwd(); workset=json.loads((root/'.ai/task/repair-w45-20260927/WORKSET.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['items']
expected={(x['section'],x['source'],x['source_tag']) for x in workset}; assert len(expected)==27
loader=LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest()))
old=loader.load_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:tome-orcs.lua']),logical_path='tome-orcs.lua').translations
new=loader.load_path(root/'tome-orcs.lua',logical_path='tome-orcs.lua').translations
assert len(old)==len(new); changed=[]
for i,(b,a) in enumerate(zip(old,new)):
    assert {k:v for k,v in b.items() if k not in {'line','target'}}=={k:v for k,v in a.items() if k not in {'line','target'}}, ('non-target',i)
    if b.get('target')!=a.get('target'): changed.append(a)
actual={(x['section'],x['source'],x['source_tag']) for x in changed}; assert len(changed)==27 and actual==expected
markup=re.compile(r'#(?:\{\{[^#]*\}\}|\{[^#]*\}|[A-Za-z_]+)#|\[(?:/?[bi])\]'); fmt=re.compile(r'%(?:[-+ #0]*\d*(?:\.\d+)?[cdeEfgGiouqsxX])')
def tabs(s): return len(s)-len(s.lstrip('\t'))
def scan(s):
    out=[]; bare=False; i=0
    while i<len(s):
        if s[i]!='%': i+=1; continue
        if i+1<len(s) and s[i+1]=='%': i+=2; continue
        m=fmt.match(s,i)
        if m: out.append(m.group(0)); i=m.end(); continue
        bare=True; i+=1
    return out,bare
by={(x['section'],x['source'],x['source_tag']):x for x in changed}
for item in workset:
    src=item['source']; tgt=by[(item['section'],src,item['source_tag'])]['target']; sl=src.split('\n'); tl=tgt.split('\n'); rid=item['entry_revision_identity']
    assert len(sl)==len(tl),(rid,'line_count'); assert [i for i,x in enumerate(sl) if x.strip(' \t')=='']==[i for i,x in enumerate(tl) if x.strip(' \t')==''],(rid,'blank')
    assert list(map(tabs,sl))==list(map(tabs,tl)),(rid,'tabs'); assert src.endswith('\n')==tgt.endswith('\n'),(rid,'terminal_newline'); assert [markup.findall(x) for x in sl]==[markup.findall(x) for x in tl],(rid,'markup')
    if item['source_tag']=='tformat' or item.get('args_order') is not None:
        st,_=scan(src); tt,bare=scan(tgt); assert st==tt,(rid,'placeholders',st,tt); assert not bare,(rid,'bare_percent')

'5e598b48d4cabcc92172cf6e7bdefb743d12af66d78000af7afc69c6baffff19':'目标被灵能蠕虫感染，每回合受到 %0.2f 点精神伤害。对震慑或恐惧的敌人伤害加倍，可对半径 3 内对宿主友好且尚未感染的单位尝试传播（目标可抵抗）；宿主死亡时必定尝试，否则每回合有 25%% 几率尝试。',
'867d6d97d96ca3e34b6b93e9717772afa9c392af63d84347c69eff745bf25010':'#LIGHT_GREEN#*你进入了操作室，坐好，插入钥匙。#{bold}#裂天者 毁灭号#{normal}# 嗡嗡作响地启动了，基座在你身下微微转动。一块奇怪的针阵面板滑到你面前，针脚在磁力作用下伸出又缩回，显示出飞船的轮廓（以及一个小黑点）与以下短语：#{italic}#“发现空中目标-数目：2”。#{normal}#*#WHITE#',
'e7dd1f391bb4a2dbbbd8d1e1eab2c58077c0e1a2d749cd3f3dda4f4324a3f39b':'持用乌瑞斯拉克的股骨击杀永恒的乌瑞斯拉克。'}
for item in workset:
    rid=item['entry_revision_identity']
    if rid in expected_targets: assert by[(item['section'],item['source'],item['source_tag'])]['target']==expected_targets[rid],rid
